tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bsang gi yi ge dge legs char sprin zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

00000000 na mo shākya mu na ye/ bde chen mchog tu dga' ba'i rol mo ni// zad med mtshan brgya'i snang ba 'bum grol ba// thub mchog bla ma 'gro ba'i nyi ma de'i// dge legs zhabs sen dad brgya'i spyi bor bsnyen/ 'di na legs bshad mu tig dog pa gsar// bsang mchod ge sar phon po'i nus ma can// dad pa'i gur kum gsar pas 'bri bzhin par// thar 'dod ge sar rna ba'i bcud du len// de 'ang bkra shis byin chags pa'i sgrub gnas gang 'os su rnal 'byor pa gtsang sbra dang ldan pas/ rin po che'i snod dam thab gang rung du bsang shing phye mar spos sman dkar mngar 'bru sna lnga sogs gtsang ma'i me la bsreg pa ba mchog gi 'o chab bran/ thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ de yang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad rang gi pha mar ma gyur pa med cing bka' drin che ba sha stag tu 'dug 'on kyang da lta khams gsum srid pa'i 'khor lo chud mi za ba'i sdug bsngal gyi grong du gtses shing thar ba'i dus med pa 'di rnams la brtse ba shas mi bzod pa'i blos/ phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i dmigs yul du byas te/ rang snang rnam dag 'od gsal thig le'i zhing*// dag pa rab 'byams 'og min chen po'i mkhar// rang rig ye shes rtsa gsum zhi khro'i lha// phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs sras bcas tshogs// til gyi gang bu phye ba ltar bzhugs pa// 'phags pa'i ye shes lkog tu ma gyur pa'i// sgrib med brtse ba'i thugs kyis deng dgongs la// bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can bskyab tu gsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la// bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can rnams// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// lan gsum/ sems bskyed pa ni/ mtha' med khams gsum srid pa'i rgya mtsho 'dir// mun nag mun pa chen po'i las bsags shing*// mun gling chen por yang yang ltung gyur pa'i// mkha' khyab rigs drug ma rgan yid can rnams// rig gsal rang rig bde chen thar gling du// bgrod phyir byang chub sems mchog bskyed par bgyi//

lan gsum/ tshogs zhing ni/ a: chos dbyings longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul pa'i sku// 'od gsal thig le zang thal klong yangs par// rabs 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa// snang srid thams cad mer mer shig shig gsal// de klong pad nyi'i gdan steng khyon yangs par// zag bcas mi snang skad cig dran rdzogs su// rgyal kun 'dus zhal mtsho skyes thod phreng rtsal// chu las chu bur rdol 'dra mtshan dpe'i sku// lo brgyad lang tsho khro 'dzum 'gying bag can// mnyen lcug 'khril ldem rjes chags zim bu'i spyan// ut+pal rgyas 'dra chu skyes bun pas btud// rin chen rgyan mdzes dar gyi smad dkris dang*// thor tshugs rin chen 'bar ba'i rtse bran can// bde chen 'od lnga'i gur khang 'khyil ba de'i// rang snang gzhi dbyings dwangs ma'i mkha' spyod du// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lhun grub bkod 'bar ba// nyi zla 'bum gyi zer ltar 'od 'phro zhing*// rang rang sku las sprul pa'i 'khor longs spyod// gsang mchog gsung gi gsang ba mi zad dang*// mkhyen brtse thugs rje rol pa'i rgyan 'khor gyis// khams gsum rigs drug 'gro ba 'di dang 'di// gdul bya'i lhag ma ma lus yongs sgrol ba'i// snang srid ma hā gu ru gsal bar bskyed// skyabs gnas kun gyi thugs rje'i rol gar las// bzhin lag rnam par shar ba mtshan dpe'i gzugs// thogs med gshegs la rig 'dzin slob dpon che'i// steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu bzhugs su gsol// mi phyed dang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal zhing*// 'dzad med kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin stob// sdig ltung nyes pa'i tshogs kun so sor bshags// dus gsum dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*// zab cing rgya che'i chos 'khor bskor bar bskul// gzugs sku bskal brgyar mi g.yo gsol ba 'debs// dus gsum rnam par dkar ba'i dge ba'i las// kun bzang gdod ma'i go 'phang thob phyir bsngo//

bsang rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐/ rang nyid rdor sems spyi bor rigs kyi bdag /bla ma kun bzang mtshan dpe'i gar mkhan can// sbyong spel bsgyur thob tshim zhing dbang byed lha'i// thugs ka'i sa bon 'od zer 'phro 'du las// mi mthun nyes pa'i skyon tshogs rab sbyangs te// 'dod pa'i re ba ma lus skong gyur cig /oṃ shud+dhe shud+dhe sho dha na ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐/ oṃ swa bhā wa shu dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa bi shudho haṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bhi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ṭa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ na ma:sarba ta thā ga ta ā wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ oṃ dzñā ā wa lo ki te na mas+sa man+ta s+pha ra ṇa ra smi bha wa ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hri da ya dzo la ni swā hā/ na mas+sa man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ gra te shwa ri pra bhañdza na ma hā sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing phyag rgya rnams bya'o// gzhung dngos la 'jug pa'i bdag bskyed ni/ hūm̐/ klong bde chen mi 'gyur zhi ba'i ngang*// mgon thugs rje chen po'i 'od zer gyi// zhing dag pa rab 'byams pad+ma 'di// gnas zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang na// rje rgyal ba kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung*// sku mtshan dpe'i 'dzum 'od me re re// gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs snyan dir ri ri// thugs gsal stong 'dzin med hrigs se hrig /lha zhi khro'i 'gying bag gshigs se shig /yab dpa' bo'i gar stabs khrabs se khrab// ma dpa' mo'i glu len shar ra ra// ding pho nya'i bro brdung chems se chem// mdangs 'ja' mtshon 'od lnga khyugs se khyug /khyed thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs kyi// gnas 'di ru byin chen char ltar phob// rdzas bsang mchod kun la nus pa skyed// bdag 'dir tshogs rnams la dngos grub stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/

mgron spyan 'dren pa ni/ kyai/ gdod nas rnam dag 'khor ba mya ngan 'das// ma skyes mi 'gags lhun grub gzhal yas khang*// chos sku'i dkyil 'khor longs sku'i rgyan gyis mdzes// sprul sku'i mchod sprin nam mkha' mtha' bkang zhing*// de dbus mdzes ldan mdun gyi nam mkha' la// skyabs gnas bla ma mchog dang dkon mchog gsum// yi dam chos skyong dam can chos srung ba// mthun rkyen spel mdzad rigs brgyud 'go ba'i lha// srid gsum gnas pa'i sde brgyad gzhi bdag sogs// ma lus spyan 'dren thogs med 'dir gshegs la// rang rang dgyes pa'i stan la brtan par bzhugs// phyi nang mchod tshogs bsangs kyis mnyes gyur cig / bsang gyer ba ni/ hūm̐/ 'gyur med mkha' khyab chos sku spros bral la// gsang gsum mi zad rnam rol longs spyod rdzogs// thugs rjes 'gro la cir snang sprul pa'i sku// 'gro ba'i dbang por 'tsham pa'i sgyu drwa'i gar// gzhom gzhig bral ba 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku// 'gag pa med pa'i sgra dbyangs nā da'i gsung*// shes bya kun mkhyen rang rtsal rig pa'i thugs// gdod nas rnam dag lhun grub kun tu bzang*// ma rig 'khrul ngor 'khor ba'i chu nang du// phan gnod byed por btags pa'i 'jig rten lha// zla ba gcig las shar ba'i 'bum phrag gzugs// ji bzhin rang gi sems kyi rol pa'i rtsal// dag dang 'dag bya dag byed yul bral yang*// sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i 'khrul 'khor ji bzhin du// mi gtsang nyes pa'i tshogs kun sel ba dang*// dngos grub stsol phyir bsangs kyi mchod pa 'bul// kyai/ kun dga'i dpal ster dpyid kyi pho nya yis// legs drangs chu 'dzin gsar pa'i lang long can// lha lam 'gram pa'i ngos su 'khrigs pa dang*// lhan cig dbyar gyi rnga gsang stong ldir zhing*// mun sel dmar 'od glog gi zhags pa 'khyug /nam yang 'dzad pa med pa'i char rgyun gyis// gser ldan dga' ma'i bzhin ras yongs bkrus tshe// rtsi shing sman mchog skra yi lan bu g.yo// dri bzang ngad ldan rkang 'thung yal 'dab dang*// 'bru mar rin chen rtsi bcud bsregs pa yi// dud pa'i sprin tshogs lha yi chu bo ltar// mi mthun nyes kun sel ba'i cho ga mkhan// de phyir rgyal dbang pad+ma sam+bha bas// gangs can bstan pa'i sgron me sbar ba'i tshe// bsang mchod 'phrin las grangs med rgyas btab ste// 'jigs med sgrom bur gsang ba'i gter du sbas// mgon der mos ldan rdo rje'i mched lcam rnams// sngon rabs dam pa'i rjes su 'jug pa'i blos// kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin la 'gran nus pa'i// gus pa'i lha bsang mchod las sri zhur bgyi// kyai/

gser gyi mdangs la 'khu ba'i lo 'dab tshogs// g.yur du za ba'i ljon shing stag pas bsangs// g.yu yi mdog can gnam sngon zhun ma dag /'khyil 'dra'i 'dab ma rab rgyas shug pas bsangs// rab dkar dung gi mdangs la 'gran bzod pa'i// phang phung 'dab ma bzhad pa'i 'khan pas bsangs// mchong gi mdog ltar rab dmar lo 'dab kyi// phang phung mdzes par rgod pa'i ba lus bsangs// bzang drug sman dang spos dkar ma nu dang*// tsan dan dkar dmar a ka ru yis bsangs// bdud rtsi can gyi ljon pa'i shing gi tshogs// phye mar zas phud 'bru sna'i rigs kyis bsangs// dar dang za 'og rin chen rnam pa lnga// dkar gsum mngar gsum la sogs mthun pa'i rdzas// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs nas// rang rang 'dod pa'i dngos por gyur pas bsangs// kyai/ tshe gcig sangs rgyas sgrub pa zab mo'i theg /smin byed dbang dang grol bar byed pa'i khrid// rgyab rten lung dang rgyud bshad man ngag dang*// bka' gter gdams pa stsol ba'i byed pa po// khyab bdag thog ma'i mgon po nas bzung ste// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar byon pa'i// rgya bod mkhas dang grub pa'i rig 'dzin tshogs// dngos brgyud rdo rje slob dpon thams cad bsangs// sde snod gsum dang sgra tshad bzo gso sogs// grangs med rig pa'i gnas rnams ston mkhas pa'i// 'phags yul kha ba'i ljongs 'dir snga byung dang*// da ltar byon pa'i mkhas grub thams cad bsangs// kha ba can du thub bstan chos kyi sgo// thog mar 'dren mdzad khri srong lha'i me tog /dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo pad+ma 'byung*// mkhan chen zhi 'tsho rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs// bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa thams cad bsangs// lha chos bdun ldan jo bo yab sras dang*// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag brtse chen snying po'i zhabs// dgyes mdzad sgra bsgyur rgyal po mar pa rje// khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa// phan bde'i rnam 'dren chen po thams cad bsangs// kyai/

lhun grub dbang gzhu ltar bkra mtshan dpe'i gar// bde bar gshegs pa rigs lnga la sogs pa'i// bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis lha yi 'khor lo mchog /bcom ldan zhi ba'i lha tshogs thams cad bsangs// in+d+ra nī la'i lhun po dus mtha'i mes// mngon par rab klubs bdud bzhi las rgyal ba// lnga bcu rtsa brgyad 'jigs rung he ru ka /khrag 'thung khro bo'i lha yi tshogs kun bsangs// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las can// rbod gtong rig 'dzin mchod bstod drag sngags lha// bde gshegs rgyal ba ma lus rab 'dus pa'i// grangs med dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs bsangs// bde phag rgyal rgyam kye rdor gsang ba 'dus// gdan gzhi ma ya la sogs rgyud sde bzhi'i// mtha' yas brjod par dka' ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi// 'khor lo'i bdag nyid lha yi tshogs kun bsangs// dur khrod brgyad dang nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul// sum cu rtsa bdun gnas dang mkha' spyod sogs// bgrang yas ngo mtshar zhing na legs bzhugs pa'i// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs thams cad bsangs// kyai/ chos dbyings klong las ma g.yos srin po'i gzugs// gdug pa 'dul phyir ma hā kā la'i gtso// khrag 'thung rdo rje'i gtso mo 'dod khams dbang*// bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams bsangs// 'jigs byed ma hā kā la phyag bzhi drug /gur zhal beng dang rgyal chen rnam mang sras// legs ldan dur bdag trak+shad bdud mgon nag /pu tra ming sring beg gdong lcam dral bsangs// ma ning e ka dza ti dpa00000000la lha mo// thang lha stag bzhon gza' bdud bdud mgon dang*// 00000000sprul pa'i chos rgyal btsan rgod rdo rje legs// bstan pa bcu gnyis tshe ring mched lnga bsangs// ra sa 'phrul snang dpal gyi bsam yas dang*// mtha' 'dul yang 'dul ru gnon gtsug lag khang*// dben gnas chos 'khor ma lus skyong ba dang*// chos dang gter gyi srung ma ma lus bsangs// rje yi mgur lha 'bangs kyi srog lha dang*// srid pa chags pa'i lha chen dgu la sogs// pur rgyal bod kyi rgyal khams skyong byed pa'i// gzhi bdag srung ma mthu chen ma lus bsangs// rgya gar li bal rgya nag hor gyi yul// mnga' ris skor gsum dbus gtsang ru bzhi dang*// mdo stod mdo smad la sogs 'dzam gling gi

/yul gru kun gyi gzhi bdag srung ma bsangs// lha klu gnod sbyin ma bdud dmu btsan dang*// rgyal po gshin rje gza' dang rgyu skar sogs// mdor na snang zhing srid pa'i lha ma yin// sde brgyad bran g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa bsangs// kyai/ 'dzam gling shar ljongs kun gsal 'dzin ma'i ltor// srid zhi'i ngo mtshar 'char ba'i tha'i wan zhes// grags dkar rna ba'i bdud rtsir spud pa yi// yul skyong rje btsan lha klu lha min tshogs// gnod sbyin sde brgyad 'byung po ma lus dang*// gnyug gnas glo bur lhags pa'i mgron rigs rnams// kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtshos mnyes gyur cig /dbus phyogs tha'i krung yun ling zhing gi char// ri mtsho bzhi mdo ljon shing mkhar dang brag /grong dang grong khyer 'dus gzhir gnas pa yi// lha btsan sde brgyad 'byung po ma lus bsangs// krang hā me'o rlid nan do'o yul gyi char// ri mtsho ljon shing lteng ka nags tshal dang*// lam srang bzhi mdo grong mkhar la gnas pa'i// lha klu lha min 'byung po ma lus bsangs// shar phyogs tha'i tung hā lan zhing gi char// ri mtsho ljon shing lteng ka nags tshal dang*// lam srang bzhi mdo gro mkhar la gnas pa'i// lha klu lha min 'byung po ma lus bsangs// lho phyogs tha'i nan cā g.yid zhing gi char// ri mtsho bzhi mdo ljon shing mkhar dang brag /khyad par 00000000ka'o zhung bing tung la gnas pa'i// 00000000lha klu lha min 'byung po ma lus bsangs// byang phyogs tha'i 00000000sba'i do'o yon zhing gi char// 00000000ri mtsho bzhi mdo ljon shing mkhar dang brag /khyad par shing kru'u yi'i lan la gnas pa'i// lha klu lha min 'byung po ma lus bsangs// gzhan yang grong dang gnas khang ri brag lam// mtsho dang rdzing bu lteng ka chu ngogs dang*// gling dang nye ba'i gling du gnas pa yi// lha dang klu dbang 'byung po ma lus bsangs// mdor na bdag sogs 'khor dang bcas rnams la// lus dang grib ma bzhin du rab 'grogs nas// stong grogs dpung gnyen byed pa'i lha tshogs rnams// bsang gi mchod pas mnyes shing tshim gyur cig

/kyai/ khyad par bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi// bsam pa'i don sgrub rigs dang brgyud rnams spel// mi 'dzad nor ster rgyab rten mgon skyabs mdzad// dpa' rtsal mthu stobs skyed pa'i lha rnams bsangs// dbang po lnga yi so so'i byed las kyis// las rnams thogs med sgrub la dbang ba'i lha// mgyogs pa'i rta dang sra ba'i go cha'i tshogs// rnon po'i mtshon char gnas pa'i dgra lha bsangs// mtho la zhu 'bul dma' la bka' bsgo zhing*// mnyam par gshags 'gyed phyogs su don gnyer ba// tshong dang khe spogs dmag jag 'grul bzhud sogs// bya ba kun la dbang ba'i lha rnams bsangs// 'go ba'i lha lnga mi thub dgra lha gsum// khang khyim thab kha mkhar gyi rtsa lha dang*// zhing dang phyugs lhas sgo dang lam gyi lha// pha mes mi rabs brgyud kyi dgra lha bsangs// rmugs rabs brgyud dang rtsugs rabs brgyud kyi lha// slob dpon brgyud la 'go ba'i lha rnams dang*// 'gro ba'i lam dang gzhis kyi srung ma'i tshogs// rgyan gos longs spyod grogs la gnas pa bsangs// yar lha sham po gung rgyal spom ra dang*// brgya byin dkar nag khra gsum wer ma'i tshogs// srid pa'i lha lung rno mthong ston pa'i lha// mdung lha sum brgya drug cu la sogs bsangs// yab lha rdal drug ma btsun rgyal ma mthang*// 'dos rigs sman pa bco brgyad ma chags stong*// stongs dang 'byung ba chags pa'i dgra lha dang*// a kar dkar gyi srung ma ma lus bsangs// sku lha gyer 'dzom lha 'u g.yang dkar dang*// bod kyi mi 'u gdung drug zo dor lha// thugs dkar sum brgya drug cu la sogs pa'i// mdor na g.yung drung bon gyi lha rnams bsangs// lo skor bcu gnyis spar kha rnam pa brgyad// sme ba dgu dang sa bdag rgyal blon 'bangs// spor thang brgyad cu skor gyi gtsug lag lha// gab rtse dgu la gnas pa'i lha rnams bsangs// nyin srib ri dang nags tshal lteng ka dang*// lam chen bzhi mdo chu klung ljon pa'i shing*// rang byung bcos ma'i me dang rlung sa sogs// so sor dbang ba'i phyogs 'di'i gzhi bdag bsangs//

nyams sgrib bshags pa ni/ hūm̐/ de ltar rtsa gsum chos srung sde brgyad dang*// yul lha gzhi bdag dgra lha la sogs pa// gtsang zhing gya nom mang por spel ba yi// dag byed bsang gi mchod pa 'di phul bas// gdod nas rnam dag gsal stong rig pa'i gshis// ma rig 'khrul pas bslad pa'i nad gnod bgegs// thag khra sbrul du mthong ba'i dngangs skrag bzhin// med kyang mngon sum snang ba'i skyon tshogs rnams// mkha' khyab don dam chos sku bde ba cher// chu la chu bzhag lta bur ro gcig kyang*// kun rdzob rdzun ngor grub pa'i nyes pa kun// dag byed chu yis dri ma 'khrud ltar bshags// khyad par bdag cag rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag rnams// so thar byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang*// rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig nyams pa'i grib// gdol dang dme yugs ya bshan mdze grib dang*// lha dang mi la 'khon dang rtsod pa'i grib// dkar dmar thab gzhob bya spyod mi mkhas pa'i// mi gtsang rigs rnams lag tu bstar zhing bcangs// zas su zos shing gos su gyon pa dang*// gnas mal 'khor nor longs spyod bsten pa sogs// ljon shing mthun rdzas bsregs pa'i dud sprin 'dis// ma lus byang zhing rnam par dag gyur nas// gangs kyi ri mo lta bur gsal gyur cig /phun tshogs bkra shis dus bzang yar gyir ngor// gza' skar dus sbyor legs pa 'phrod kyi dge /mthun pa'i rkyen kun tshang ba'i gnas mchog 'dir// bsang gis mchod pa'i 'bras bu lhun grub shog /hūm̐/ bsang mchod mthun pa'i dam rdzas rgya chen po// dngos bshams yid kyis sprul te phul ba'i mthus// skyabs mchog ngo bo rtsa gsum lha tshogs kyis// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char ltar phob// srung ma dam can sde brgyad tshogs rnams kyis// bcol ba'i phrin las ma lus thogs med sgrubs// yul lha gzhi bdag 'go ba'i lha rnams kyis// bar chad sel zhing bsam pa'i re ba skongs// mdor na mchod yul dam pa khyed rnams kyis// bdag cag mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la// seng ge glang chen smyon pa me sbrul dang*// lcags sgrog sha za rgya mtsho chen po ste// 'jigs chen brgyad dang gdon bgegs nad rims dgra// dus min 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa dang*// kha smra mi kha gleng gzhi 'thab rtsod sogs// bar chad mi mthun g.yul las rgyal bar mdzod// rgud pa'i mun stug rdzogs pa'i thun gsum mthar// shar ba'i legs byas skya rengs kyis drangs pa'i// phan bde'i nyin mor byed pa'i 'od zer gyis// zhi ba'i 'phrin las snang ba 'bar bar mdzod// bsod nams dus las yol med rlabs phreng can// tshe dpal 'byor pa mi zad chu bo'i gter// bsam pa'i re ba skong ba'i yid bzhin nor// rgyas pa'i 'phrin las rgyal mtshan rtser 'god mdzod// reg pas gdung sel yid dga'i mdza' na mo// 'gugs byed lho phyogs rlung gi reg bya can// mthong na mi mthun med pa'i tsan dan shing*// dbang gi 'phrin las dri bsung 'thul bar mdzod// 'khu ba'i sems ldan lha min dga' ma'i mngal// drag sbyor rdo rje rtse brgya gdengs tsam gyis// bsod nams dpung dang lhan cig ltung byed pa'i// drag po'i phrin las legs bris stobs ldan mdzod// sgrib gnyis sgo nga'i sbubs las rnam grol ba'i// tshogs gnyis 'dab ldan ka la piṅka'i bya// rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i mkha' dbyings su// 'phur nas chos kyi dbyangs snyan sgrogs par mdzod// khyad par shar ljongs nor gling tha'i wan du// rgud tshogs nyer 'tshe'i smag mun rnam bsal nas// chos 'byor zhi bde'i lang tsho'i rta ljang dbang*// phun tshogs sde bzhi'i 'od rnon bskyed par mdzod// 'dzam gling spyi dang khyad par yul phyogs der// phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas thub pa'i bstan// bstan 'dzin skyes bu 'gro ba'i bde skyid kun// kun nas 'phel zhing rgyas pa dbyar gyi chu// chu gter chen po'i dpal la 'gran par mdzod// de mthus 'dzam gling yangs pa'i rgyal khams kun// phan tshun dmag 'khrugs dus mtshon nad mug zhi// tshe g.yang skyid kyi nyi ma dgung la shar// zad med dga' ba rgyas pa'i bkra shis mdzod// dung dung snying nas mi phyed gsol 'debs shing*// yang yang mchod cing bstod na bdag sogs kun// 'jigs 'jigs bar chad dgra las rnam rgyal zhing*// 'dzum 'dzum dgyes pa'i sgo nas dngos grub stsol//

phywa g.yang 'gugs pa ni/ kyai: 'ja' lus rdo rje chos sku'i g.yang rwa 'dir: 'od lnga ma 'gags 'ja' zer thig le'i g.yang : snang srid 'od gsal mkha' spyod dbyings nas khug: 'ja' lus 'pho ba chen po'i dngos grub stsol// gu ru'i sbas yul dpa' bo ḍā ki'i klong : khor yug thams cad lha dang lha mos gang : mchog thun dngos grub ci bsam g.yang khug cig: tshe dpal bsod nams rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol: srid zhi 'dod rgur spungs pa'i g.yang rwa 'dir: rgyan ldan gces phrug gzhon nus lha gsol gang ཿ bu nor ci bsam 'dod rgu'i g.yang khug cig: phun tshogs dpal 'byor dngos grub thams cad stsol: g.yang chang bkra shis mda' dar phye mar dang : srid pa'i lha chen dgyes pa'i mchod rdzas 'bul: phu nas gnod sbyin mched lngas nor g.yang khug: mda' nas mtsho sman bstan mas dngos grub stsol: bar na bdud btsan 'bar ba spun bdun dang : skyes mchog rdo rje legs pas bsam don 'grub: yul phyogs 'di la bkra shis dpal 'bar dang : dkar po'i dam chos dar ba'i 'phrin las mdzod: zhi ba'i las mdzad byang sems ldan rnams kyis: nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi bas 'phrin las mdzod: rgyas pa'i las mdzad rin chen rigs rnams kyis: tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol: dbang gi las mdzad pad+ma'i rigs rnams kyis: khams gsum dbang du 'dus pa'i dngos grub stsol: drag po'i las mdzad las kyi rigs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs tshar gcod nus pa'i dngos grub stsol: bsam don ma lus 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol: nongs pa bzod par gsol ba ni/ hūm̐/ rmongs pa'i dbang gis 'phrin las 'khrul par gyer// mchod pa'i dam rdzas ma tshang 'bags pa sogs// nyes pa'i tshogs kun snying nas bshags byed na// bzod par bzhes shig thugs rje che ldan rnams// gshegs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐/ chu las chu bur rdol ba ji bzhin du// rig pa'i rtsal gyis mgron du bsus pa rnams// ngo bo gdod nas skye ba med pa'i klong*// rnam pa rang rang so so'i gnas su gshegs// badz+ra muḥ

shis par brjod pa ni/ hūm̐/ yid bzhin nor dang bum bzang 'dod 'jo'i ba// dpag bsam shing ltar 'dod pa'i re ba kun// 'bad med stsol mdzad bla ma yi dam dang*// mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i bkra shis shog / gzhan yang shis par brjod pa'i me tog ka ma la'i char bzang po bsnyil bar bya'o// zhes shar gling tha'i wan gyi yul du nye bar mkho ba'i bsang mchod phrin gsol dang bcas pa dge legs char sprin 'di ni don gnyer can du mas 'bad pa chen pos bskul ma mdzad pa ltar/ shākya'i dge sbyong du rlom pa'i gyi na ba karma pa o rgyan 'phrin las rdo rjes dus gsum 'byon par dka' ba'i 'dren mchog dam pa rnams kyi zhal gsung dri ma med pa thos pa tsam gyis ngan song gi srid pa hrul por byed pa'i byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che ba rnams khrigs su bsdebs te/ khyu mchog ces pa lcags sbrul hor zla gnyis pa'i yar ngor gsang chen rig pa 'dzin pa'i chos sde dpal stod rgyud du sbyar ba dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
